stances.summary: Warns NVIDIA dependent on handful of customers for revenue concentration risk
stances.quote:
NVIDIA is basically resting on a few companies' spend.
70% of its Q2 FY27 accounts receivable comes from five companies. In Q2, one customer was 16% ($15.39bn) of revenue, and for the first half of FY27, 44% of revenue came from 3 customers.

stances.summary: Argues Meta's AI spending destroying cash generation, forcing debt or share issuance
stances.quote: All of this would've been quite different in the pre-AI era, as Meta would've just sat there and raked in cash. Meta's last quarterly FCF was $800 million, spending $30bn+ in capex. This almost certainly means it'll need more debt/an at-the-market share sale

stances.summary: Criticizes regulatory settlement as damaging to Meta's already-brittle platforms
stances.quote:
Not quite! $12bn is up front, the rest over (annoyingly) 10 years. $12bn is a great deal of money for a company that's no longer printing cash. Facebook/instagram are also brittle creatures, and these agreed-upon changes will likely cause lasting damage to engagement

stances.summary: Contends Meta settlement existential threat given massive planned AI capex
stances.quote:
To be clear: they should've got more!
But $17bn is genuinely an existential amount of money for Meta, and because it's a settlement it'll actually get paid vs. endless appeals. This is no longer a cash-rich company. It wants to spend $145bn on capex in 2026 alone!

stances.summary: Claims regulatory settlement represents material threat to cash-constrained Meta
stances.quote:
So, sort of, but worth considering:
1. $17bn is largest than meta's last quarterly profit (around $15bn)
2. Meta is demolishing its FCF because of AI, and $17bn is a REALLY big chunk of change
3. Meta's user growth is stalling

stances.summary: AI bubble fundamentally dishonest, exploited media and finance weaknesses
stances.quote:
The AI bubble is fundamentally dishonest, existing as multiple lies compounded upon each other. It exploited every weakness in our media and financial ecosystem, and it'll take years to fully comprehend its damage.

stances.summary: AI bubble made life harder, enabled enshittification through deception

stances.summary: AI breakthroughs contingent on unsustainable capital and compute infrastructure
stances.quote:
Training LLMs requires billions of dollars on tap and endless compute infrastructure, and that capital won't be available at that scale once the bubble bursts. "AI breakthroughs" are entirely contingent on near-infinite resources.
